content: Caputiapimbo icquid bëdamiaid
Adnubien abi nidteniacpadën ushë budec 3 yanuc Petedo Uambëd Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid yacno Nuquin Papa chiec nidpanëdash.

Ambo nidnubien caputiapimbocquid aid shubu shëcuë Bëdaidquio caid yacno utsibon buampanëdash. Anin tishacchobi yec caputiapimbocquid icpanëdash. Aidi badiadquidën-badiadquidënquien buandenequin aid shëcuë cuëmano nanded-nandedac uequimbi cho-chosho isun: —¿Adabi piucquid menetsia? —cabampanëdash.
Ambo Petedobëd Uan chosho isquin: —¿Adabi piucquid menetsia? —capanëdash caputiapimbocquidën uequin.
Adoaquien Uambëd nidtuidash nidquin Petedon: —Ëbi daëdi is —capanëdash caputiapimbocquid bëisquin.
Adoaquien, Ëbi menepashun, quequin abi daëdi isobien,
Petedon: —Piucquid con na nibëdec. Ëmbi tantiaidën ëbi tantiamebocpaden naimbique. Nasaded yacno iccondaidën Esusën bëdamiacpadec bëdanash nidtoash nidec nid —capanëdash.
Aden chuiquin caputiapimbocquidën mëdante abiucquio bedtanquin Petedon nidtomiac badedquio nidtopanëdash caputiapimbocboedi.

Bëdambo yec nidtoash capupanëdash. Adec bëdanash Petedobëd Uan chedobëd capuashic Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaidën puduedash, Nuquin Papan bëdamioshi, quec pudundotan-pudundotanec: —Cuishon —quepanëdash.
Adec capusho isquidon nadobededpanëdash:
—Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid shëcuë, Bëdaidquio caid yacno uetsequi, Piucquid ëbi menepashun, queboedi capueque. En is. ¡Adpaidie. Is! Tantiadempamboctequid nec —quequin isbededpanëdash.
Adec capuequi Petedobëdta Uan mëdinec Sadomonën tacpan quënë uabicquid yacno puduednubien iccuededquid tsibanash anotsen tantiadempambo yec tabadoapanëdash.

Adec tabadsho isun Petedon naden chuibampanëdash: —¿Atotsi quiash padtec quequin ëbi daëdi comapenen bëise? ¿Ëbi daëdshun nacta nëid capupadic? ¿Ëbi bëdambocquid icquindambi nadio? Padenquio. Nuquin tsusedpabon Papa caidën bëdamiaid nec.

Aidi Abadauan padon Papa caid nec. Aidbidi Isac padon Papa caid neoaic. Aidbidi Acobo padon Papa caid neoaic. Aidon Papa caidëmbi ambi nidaidën chomiaid Esus nëbi aton Papabëd tabadoaic. Aton Papa yacno nidoabicsho Esus bedshun Pidato meniaquien, Nëid dada icsaisa neque. Nidmenu, quequin tantiaquin Pidaton chiaqui, Icsambocquid nec. Unës uaquimbien ictiad, quequin mibitedishun chuipondac.
Icsaisa nec, quequin utsin isnubi Esus bunenquiocquin icsaquid cuidenquiocquin nidme, quequin mimbi chuipondac.
Abia uincuentequid mibi chuiquid dapa mimbi unës uacshobien Nuquin Papan aidi uincuemepondash. Aid uincuenacsho ëbitedishun isondambi.
Esusën ëbi bëdamepec, quequin tantiash nëid taë icsacboedën Esus tantiash capusho mibitedishun isec.
“Utsibo, Nuquin Papan chomiaid nec, quequin tantienquiocquin mibi chuiquidobëdtan mimbi Esus unës uamiondac.
Ëmbi matses chuiquid dapa icmenu caid matsesën mëyanaid iquendac, quequin ambi chuimiaidtedi Nuquin Papan dada uamiampicpaden mimbi naondac.
Nëbi mimbi icsamboen tantiaid ënquin Nuquin Papa tantiata ma mibi icsaid bëpiscudpanuna; adecbidi ma abëdi tabadebi, quequin tantiec mibi bëdambo icpanuna;
adecbidi ma ambi chuiquid dapa icmiaid Esus mibi bedmenuen chomepanuna.
Nuquin Papan abitedi icsaisa icmete ushë choabicnuc ambi chiampicpadequi nëbi Esus abuc aton Papabëd tabadec.
Adembidi chuiquin Moisesën dada uampid nad iqueque. Tantiata:

content.text: ‘Chuiquid Dapa ëbipadquid ambi chuimiaid utsi yuecshun Nuquin Papan chomendac. Isadaidbobidi aid iquendac. Aid choshon chuibansho tantiashun bëdamboen nabanta.
Ambi chiaid tantiesa Nuquin Papan nësecaindac,’ quequin Moisesën dada uampic.

content: “Adomboembidi Samuedën chuibampampic. Adomboembidi Nuquin Papan chuimiaid utsibon chuibanoampic.

Nuquin Papan chuimiaidon tsyuecquido mibitedi nec. Tsusedpa Abadauanën tsyuecquidobidi mibitedi neoaic. Aidon tsyuecquido icsho Nuquin Papan Abadauan chiampicpaden chuioaid mibitedi nec. Naden Abadauan Nuquin Papan chuipampic:

content.text: ‘Mibi ëndenquimbo unësampin aton matsesbëdta matses utsi-utsien min tsyuecquidën bëdambo icmendac.’

Nuquin Papan Abadauan chiampicpadec aton tsyuecquid choacsho mimbi unës uapondac. Aidi Nuquin Papan uincuemiac ma isadaidbomba abi icsaid ënsho ma ambi bëdambo icmiaid icpanuna —quepanëdash Petedobëd Uan.
